findings.title: [P2] Return zero for empty input and the mean otherwise
findings.body: When `values` is empty, this branch divides by zero; when it is nonempty, the function returns `0` rather than its arithmetic mean. Invert the branch behavior to match the documented contract. This is the intentional smoke-test defect described in the PR, but it remains the actionable line finding the fixture is designed to elicit.

review_output.overall_explanation: The new function violates its documented behavior for both empty and nonempty inputs. The defect is intentional for this temporary review fixture.
